note: Schema only. No hypothesis instances exist yet under this pilot as of WP0.

required_fields.optimization_hypothesis_id: string, pilot-local namespace 'SSC1D-H<n>' -- never 'HYP_00N', which is reserved for canonical SSC lineage
required_fields.observed_problem: string, must cite concrete evidence (metric + source artifact), not intuition
required_fields.supporting_metrics: array of pointers into a specific baseline decomposition report/field
required_fields.mechanism: string, causal explanation; if it duplicates an existing canonical hypothesis mechanism (e.g. HYP_001_EXIT_CAPTURE's exit-target mechanism), must say so explicitly and justify why a separate non-canonical pilot exploration is still warranted
required_fields.controlled_change_family: string, e.g. 'exit target geometry', 'setup selectivity', 'session gate'
required_fields.parameters_frozen: explicit array or statement -- must not be implied by omission
required_fields.rejection_condition: string, fixed before any candidate result is observed

governance_notes: No unrestricted parameter search is permitted under any hypothesis instance.
A hypothesis instance must be fully populated in this shape before its first candidate (see SSC1D_WP0_candidate_ledger_schema.json) is built.

This schema does not itself authorize optimization; SSC1D-WP1 or later must obtain owner sign-off on a per-hypothesis PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE decision rule before backtesting any candidate under a hypothesis (see SSC_ONE_DAY_DEMO_PILOT_V2.md section 6.1).
